mood.label: CAUTIOUSLY-RISK-ON
mood.summary: Tech and AI-related names are showing strong leadership after positive earnings, but the broader market is mixed ahead of key PPI inflation data. Oil prices are retreating, easing some cost pressures.

indicesNarrative: US futures are pointing to a slightly higher open, with tech continuing to show relative strength following yesterday's softer CPI print and strong AI-related earnings. The drop in the VIX suggests reduced anxiety, but the market is largely in a holding pattern ahead of the Producer Price Index (PPI) report, which will be the next major inflation data point.
technicalsNarrative: Technical data was not available. Traders should proceed with caution and rely on price action and volume cues.

sectorsThemes.name: Semiconductors
sectorsThemes.note: Very strong overnight action in Asian markets (SK Hynix +9%) suggests continued momentum in this group.

sectorsThemes.name: Energy
sectorsThemes.note: Under pressure as WTI crude oil prices fall over 2% due to a large build in US inventories and weaker demand forecasts.

sectorsNarrative: A clear rotation into technology and semiconductor stocks is underway, fueled by a strong AI narrative and positive earnings surprises. Energy is the notable laggard due to falling crude prices.

traderLens.name: Minervini
traderLens.view: Market is showing signs of a bifurcated character. Focus on leaders in strong sectors like Semis (SMCI) that are in confirmed Stage 2 uptrends.

traderLens.name: Ted Zhang
traderLens.view: Clear institutional flow into AI and semiconductor names. The surge in the KOSPI overnight highlights this rotation. Energy is the source of funds.

traderLens.name: Clement Ang
traderLens.view: Market context is improving but remains tentative ahead of PPI data. Only A-grade setups in leading groups should be considered. Not an environment for chasing extended names.

traderLens.name: SRxTrades
traderLens.view: Look for clean pivots and volume confirmation on entries. Avoid chasing pre-market gaps. Wait for the open to see how names like SMCI handle their momentum.

traderLens.name: Jeff
traderLens.view: Respect hard stops, especially on earnings-related plays. Weakness after an earnings report (CBRS, CSCO) is a clear signal to stay away or look for short setups.

traderLens.name: Qullamaggie
traderLens.view: Episodic pivots are in play for stocks with massive earnings beats like SMCI. Look for orderly pullbacks to the ORH for potential entries with LOD as a stop.

traderLens.name: Composite
traderLens.view: Focus on the AI/semiconductor theme, but be selective. The market is not giving a broad 'all-clear'. Raise the bar for new long entries and wait for confirmation after the PPI data. Chasing is not advised.

standout.thesis: Major episodic pivot candidate after reporting quarterly earnings and revenues far exceeding estimates, driven by the AI boom. Showing strong pre-market follow-through momentum.

alert: Key Inflation Data: US Producer Price Index (PPI) due at 08:30 ET / 20:30 MYT.
